# SF Trails

> Community-driven South Florida mountain bike trail status tracker

SF Trails (sftrails.info) is a free web application that provides live, community-reported trail status for South Florida mountain biking. Riders vote on whether each trail is currently rideable (open) or closed, and the site aggregates those votes into a real-time status badge per trail.

It answers questions like "is [trail] open today?", "what South Florida MTB trails are rideable right now?", and "are mountain bike trails near Miami / Fort Lauderdale / Boca Raton / West Palm Beach / Jupiter / Stuart open after rain?".

## Coverage

SF Trails covers the South Florida mountain biking corridor across Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and Martin counties — including the Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Jupiter, Hobe Sound, and Stuart areas.

## How It Works

- Users vote on whether each trail is "Rideable" (open) or "Closed"
- Status is calculated from votes in the last 4-12 hours
- A minimum of 3 votes is required to determine status
- Votes reset daily at midnight

## Trails

The following South Florida mountain bike trails are tracked:

- Markham Park (Sunrise) - Technical singletrack with rock gardens and log features
- Oleta River State Park (North Miami Beach) - Flowy trails through mangroves with bay views
- Virginia Key (Key Biscayne) - Tight singletrack through coastal hardwood hammock
- Quiet Waters Park (Deerfield Beach) - Beginner-friendly flat trails with fun features
- Halpatiokee Regional Park (Stuart) - Natural terrain trails through pine flatwoods
- Amelia Earhart Park (Hialeah) - Short but fun loops with tabletops and berms
- Jonathan Dickinson State Park (Hobe Sound) - Sandy singletrack through scrub and pine forest
- Riverbend Park (Jupiter) - Flowy trails along the Loxahatchee River
- Dyer Park (West Palm Beach) - Fast and flowy with nice elevation changes
- Pinehurst Park (Greenacres) - Compact trail system with good mix of terrain
- West Delray Regional Park (Delray Beach) - Well-maintained trails with progressive features
- Tree Tops Park (Davie) - Shaded trails through tropical hardwood hammock

## API

Trail data is available as JSON at the `/api/trails` endpoint. Each trail includes:
- name, city, description, location coordinates (latitude/longitude)
- current status (open, closed, or unknown)
- vote counts (open votes, closed votes, total votes)

## Markdown for agents

Every HTML page can be retrieved as markdown either by:
- sending `Accept: text/markdown`, or
- appending `.md` to the URL (`/index.md`, `/trail/markham-park.md`).

A rough token estimate is returned in the `X-Markdown-Tokens` response
header, and HTML pages advertise the markdown variant via
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.
